=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:4575-4576 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PRIOR_RUNTIME_COMMENTS_JSONL `gh api` read omits `?per_page=100`, so it pages at GitHub's default 30 per page, unlike the reads at lines 2311 and 2824.
  WHY: Cycle 2+ runs on large tracking issues make roughly 3x more paginated requests, which costs shared API quota and latency (reviewers rated it NIT; results stay correct).
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2803-2830, 4563-4596 (resolver read at 2824, prior-cycle read at 4575) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `validation_cycle_resolve` and the cycle > 1 PRIOR_RUNTIME_COMMENTS_JSONL block each paginate the same issue comments endpoint, so cycle > 1 runs read it twice.
  WHY: This doubles API quota use and latency, against §14. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 said NIT, and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave this as a performance finding with no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `validation_cycle_resolve` makes its own paginated comments read at line 2824 instead of reusing the existing fetch, and the cycle > 1 path reads the same endpoint again at lines 4575-4576. Some reviewers judged this justified by the in-code comment at lines 2803-2809: PRIOR_COMMENTS is read only at cycle > 1 and carries no authors. Severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR).
